_about: Facility-ladder fragment (List 19 #186) — the endless format slot proposed into #86's rule-set table (its home disposes). Bent rule, in #86's one-line form: the run has no set boundary — it continues until a loss, and the opposition escalates by authored rung bands. Generation is #94's contract verbatim (round = rung); no second generator. Band contents, hosts, and heads are #86's OPEN register, inherited.

model.bands: a data table maps rung ranges to #94 pool tiers + opponent level bands, under #52 B1 (bands never read the visitor) and B2 (no interpolation — a rung takes its band row whole)
model.gain: no gain events (#177's structural exclusion — levels normalised; the record is the reward)
model.generation: #94 contract verbatim with round = rung; seed derives from the run record, so every rung's party is reproducible/replayable; generated parties belong to the facility, never named Rangers (#94's boundary)
model.lossWrites: the run record only — no roster write, no honour loss, no progress change, no penalty
model.milestones: #86's HEAD pattern may seat heads at ladder rungs (milestone rungs are band-table data); heads are casting/canon — none asserted; symbol fiction remains #86's OPEN slot
model.record: {facilityId, format: 'ladder', rungsCleared, endKind, seedLine, partyIds, lostAtRung} appended to the facility run history — append-only (#126); best marks and counts derive at read (#14/#86)
model.run: a single sequence of battles (rungs, numbered from 1) with no SET boundary; ends at the first loss or a recorded withdrawal
model.visitor: the Ranger's own individuals (#80) or rental snapshots under #159 hosting (expiring at run end, including at the loss); #86 normalisation unchanged; the visitor's numbers are never scaled

open_register: which facility/isle hosts a ladder (canon — no facility exists yet, per #86)
every rung band row (pool tiers + level bands per rung range)
milestone rungs and every facility head (casting/canon, #86)
the normalisation band value (OPEN in #86, inherited)
the symbol/honour fiction for milestone wins (#86's OPEN slot, inherited)
